scripts.title: Keyboard and Mouse V3
scripts.features:
-mouse
-keyboard
scripts.script:
-- ✅ Delta Executor Full Keyboard + Mouse Hub
-- Yusuf için özel hazırlandı

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local UIGridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")

ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 500, 0, 300)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.2, 0)

UIGridLayout.Parent = Frame
UIGridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
UIGridLayout.FillDirectionMaxCells = 12
UIGridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

-- Fonksiyon: Tuş simülasyonu
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")

local function createButton(keyName, keyCode)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Parent = Frame
    button.Text = keyName
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game)
        wait(0.05)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game)
    end)
end

-- Hareket tuşları
createButton("W", Enum.KeyCode.W)
createButton("A", Enum.KeyCode.A)
createButton("S", Enum.KeyCode.S)
createButton("D", Enum.KeyCode.D)
createButton("Space", Enum.KeyCode.Space)
createButton("Shift", Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift)
createButton("Ctrl", Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)

-- Mouse Tuşları
createButton("LMB", Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
createButton("RMB", Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)

-- Sayılar
for i = 0,9 do
    createButton(tostring(i), Enum.KeyCode[""..i])
end

-- Harfler A–Z
for i = 65, 90 do
    local letter = string.char(i)
    createButton(letter, Enum.KeyCode[letter])
end

-- Fonksiyon tuşları F1–F12
for i = 1,12 do
    createButton("F"..i, Enum.KeyCode["F"..i])
end

scripts.title: trip gui
scripts.features: This is a trip gui where you click it you trip or fall.
scripts.script:
-- LocalScript inside StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Create ScreenGui
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Create Button
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.05, 0) -- Center top
button.Text = "Trip"
button.TextScaled = true
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
button.Parent = screenGui

-- Button Function
button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if humanoid then
		-- Trip (fall down)
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)

		-- Stay on ground for 5 seconds
		task.wait(5)

		-- Force stand back up
		humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
	end
end)
